name: com.roamduck/roamduck
title: Roamduck: mobile top-ups, gift cards and travel eSIMs
description: Phone top-ups in 159 countries, gift cards, travel eSIMs. Pay by crypto link or USDC via x402.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries where Roamduck sells prepaid mobile top-ups, with dialling prefixes.

tools.name: find_operator
tools.description: Detect the country and mobile operator of a phone number. Give the full international number with country code, e.g. +525512345678. If no operator comes back, ask the person.

tools.name: list_operators
tools.description: List the mobile operators Roamduck can top up in one country.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List top-up products for a country, optionally one operator. Each product has a sku, what the recipient gets, and the price the person pays (or a price range they can pick from).

tools.name: list_payment_coins
tools.description: Optional step before create_order: a short list of cryptocurrencies to offer the person as choices, each with its minimum payment. Pass amount and currency (the product price) to see which coins fit. The chosen code goes into create_order as pay_with.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a top-up order and get a payment link. Nothing is charged by this call: a person must open payment_url and pay in cryptocurrency on NOWPayments. Delivery to the phone is automatic after the payment confirms. Before calling, confirm the phone number, operator, product and price with the person: delivered top-ups cannot be reversed. You may ask which coin they want to pay with (list_payment_coins) and pass it as pay_with; it is optional. amount and currency must match the product's price (or lie inside its price_range).

currency.description: Price currency from list_products, e.g. EUR

pay_with.description: Optional coin code from list_payment_coins, e.g. usdttrc20. The payment page then opens with that coin selected.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Check any order (top-up, gift card or eSIM; see kind): waiting for payment, confirming, sending, delivered, expired, or needs attention. While waiting it repeats pay_url. Once a gift card is delivered the result holds giftcard.cards (code and PIN); once an eSIM is delivered it holds esim (QR code link, one-tap install links, LPA string). These are SECRETS for the buyer only: give them only to the person who paid, never post, share or store them anywhere else. A delivered eSIM also has usage (status not_started, active, ended or unknown; data_left_gb of data_total_gb or unlimited; ends_at; days_left), or null when it cannot be read right now.

tools.name: list_giftcard_countries
tools.description: List the countries Roamduck sells digital gift cards for, with the number of cards each.

tools.name: search_giftcards
tools.description: Find gift cards by country, brand or both (at least one), e.g. country US and query amazon. Returns id, name, brand, country, currency and the lowest price in EUR (from_eur). Cards are region locked: a card works only with accounts in its own country.

country.description: Two-letter ISO code of the card's country, e.g. US

query.description: Brand or card name, e.g. amazon

tools.name: get_giftcard
tools.description: One gift card: the values it comes in with their EUR prices (or the value range), how to redeem it, and the country it is locked to.

tools.name: create_giftcard_order
tools.description: Create a gift card order and get pay_url. Nothing is charged by this call: a person must open pay_url and pay in cryptocurrency on NOWPayments. The server sets the price from the current quote. Before calling, confirm the brand, the card's country (cards are region locked) and the value with the person: a code cannot be refunded once shown. After the payment confirms, get_order returns the code.

face.description: Card value in the card's currency: one of get_giftcard values[].face, or inside its value_range

first_name.description: Only when the value has needs_name: first name of the person the card is for

last_name.description: Only when the value has needs_name: their last name

pay_with.description: Optional coin code from list_payment_coins, e.g. usdttrc20. The payment page then opens with that coin selected.

tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: List the countries and regions Roamduck sells travel eSIMs (mobile data plans) for, with the number of plans and the lowest price in EUR.

tools.name: list_esim_plans
tools.description: List the eSIM data plans for one country or region: id, data, days, price in EUR, speed tier and number of countries covered.

destination.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. JP) or a region code from list_esim_destinations

tools.name: get_esim_plan
tools.description: One eSIM plan: price, data, days, the countries it covers with their networks and speeds, and the plan notes.

tools.name: create_esim_order
tools.description: Create an eSIM order and get pay_url. Nothing is charged by this call: a person must open pay_url and pay in cryptocurrency on NOWPayments. The server sets the price from the current quote. Before calling, confirm the plan with the person and that their phone supports eSIM and is not locked to an operator: an installed eSIM cannot be refunded. After the payment confirms, get_order returns the install data.

pay_with.description: Optional coin code from list_payment_coins, e.g. usdttrc20. The payment page then opens with that coin selected.

tools.name: pay_order_x402
tools.description: For agents with their own x402 wallet: pay an order from create_order, create_giftcard_order or create_esim_order directly in USDC instead of sending the person the payment link. Call it without payment to get the price (x402 PaymentRequired, valid 10 minutes), then again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Delivery starts as soon as the payment settles; follow it with get_order. Only for orders not paid through their link.
